# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 38 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_038_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 38

**1** Jesus said: "Many times you have desired [ецме] to hear these words [шаже] that I am saying to you, and you have no one else [кeoуа] from whom to hear them.

**2** There will be days when you will look [шіне] for me and will not find me."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *ецме*: to desire, wish, want
- *шаже*: words, sayings — the same term as the prologue
- *кeoуа*: another one, someone else — there is no other source
- V.2: a saying of urgency — the time of access is limited
- cf. Luke 17:22: "The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it"
- cf. John 7:34; 13:33: "You will seek me, and you will not find me"
